corrections.text: The Investing.com source used for the direct quote 'represents the first joint AI model created by the two companies' and for the $60 billion Cursor acquisition detail returned an HTTP 403 to the newsroom's archiver and is not preserved as a provenance snapshot. The Chief Editor confirmed both claims verbatim against the live article at review time; readers should note these two Investing.com-specific claims rest on a live verification rather than an archived snapshot. All other claims in the article are backed by archived snapshots (TechCrunch and MarkTechPost).
